# Amendment Requirements-Quality Checklist: Repository Quality Gate and Plugin Packaging

**Purpose**: Validate the quality of the requirements added or changed by the 2026-09-02 amendment — per-check ignore declarations, the formatting standard's scope and defaults policy, and the spec-tooling capability extensions. Scope is the amendment only; requirements untouched by it are covered by `spec-review.md`.
**Created**: 2026-09-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Verification Replacing Construction

The amendment's central move is that scope agreement stops being structural and becomes something checked. These items test whether the requirements say enough for that check to exist.

- [ ] CHK001 Does the spec state how scope agreement is verified, rather than only that it must hold? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013b]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the failure condition for that verification stated in terms someone could implement — what disagreement looks like, between which declarations? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013b]
- [ ] CHK003 Is "two checks disagree about a file both govern" defined precisely enough to distinguish disagreement from a file that is legitimately outside one check's content kind? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-013b]
- [ ] CHK004 Does SC-008's "verified by comparison rather than assumed, and the comparison is repeatable" state what is compared against what? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK005 Is it specified whether the verification runs as part of the aggregate check or separately from it? [Gap, Spec §FR-013b]
- [ ] CHK006 Does the spec say what happens to the aggregate verdict when the scope-agreement verification fails? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013b, §FR-007]

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK007 Are requirements stated for every check named in FR-001, including the one whose tool offers no path-exclusion mechanism? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013a, §FR-013c]
- [ ] CHK008 Does FR-013c specify what the record must contain — the absence, and what the check relies on instead? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013c]
- [ ] CHK009 Are requirements defined for how the four formatting content kinds in FR-021 relate to the content kinds already listed in FR-001? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021, §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the set of "formatting-adjacent rules" that must move out of the linting standards identified, or left for the plan to determine? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK011 Are requirements stated for what makes an extension "enabled" as distinct from installed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK012 Does FR-026 specify what "what it is permitted to change" means concretely enough to be recorded consistently for each extension? [Clarity, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK013 Are requirements defined for the extensions' own configuration file — where it lives and that it is committed? [Gap, Spec §FR-025]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK014 Is "add-on component" distinguished from "tool" and from "fallback mechanism" consistently wherever the three appear together? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK015 Can "reports which add-on components resolved" be satisfied unambiguously, or does it leave open whether the report appears on success as well as on fallback? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK016 Is "multi-line literals carry no trailing separator" stated in a way that applies unambiguously across the content kinds the formatting standard governs? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK017 Is "wherever the format being written permits them" a condition a reader can evaluate per content kind, or does it require knowing the tool's behaviour? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK018 Does FR-019 make clear which written record the relied-on defaults go in, and that the record is the same one FR-014 already mandates? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the ordering principle in FR-025a stated well enough that the rank for an extension not yet installed could be derived from it? [Measurability, Spec §FR-025a]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK020 Do FR-002 and FR-019 agree about defaults — one permitting reliance on a documented default, the other requiring its omission from the configuration file? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK021 Does FR-013a's per-check declaration conflict with FR-013's single statement of what is in scope, or are the two about different things? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, §FR-013a]
- [ ] CHK022 Do FR-023 and FR-011 draw the line in the same place between a fallback that is reachable and one that is not? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK023 Does FR-027's requirement that assessment and bug artifacts be committed and in scope conflict with FR-018's exclusion of extension state? [Conflict, Spec §FR-027, §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK024 Is FR-022's "no file is rewritten by two checks" consistent with the pre-existing edge case stating that a file claimed by two standards is checked by both? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK025 Do the amended requirements agree with the constitution at v1.2.0 rather than v1.1.0 — specifically the per-concern uniqueness rule and the undeclared-defaults rule? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019, §FR-022]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK026 Can SC-009's "0 content kinds with two of either" be counted without first deciding what counts as a governing configuration? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK027 Does SC-010 say what it compares against — a specific pinned version's documented defaults, or defaults in general? [Measurability, Spec §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK028 Is SC-011's "the same on two consecutive inspections" a sufficient test of determinism, or does it pass for an order that is stable but wrong? [Measurability, Spec §SC-011]
- [ ] CHK029 Can SC-012 be evaluated from the written principle alone, without knowing each hook's implementation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-012, §FR-025a]
- [ ] CHK030 Does SC-013 state how a machine with no add-on components is arranged for the comparison? [Clarity, Spec §SC-013]
- [ ] CHK031 Is there a success criterion covering FR-013c — that an absent exclusion mechanism was recorded rather than worked around? [Gap, Spec §FR-013c]
- [ ] CHK032 Is there a success criterion covering FR-026's provenance record? [Gap, Spec §FR-026]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK033 Are requirements stated for the recovery case where an extension is installed but its hooks cannot be ordered — a missing or malformed rank? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK034 Are requirements defined for a content kind that FR-021 governs but for which the repository holds no files? [Coverage, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the case of two extensions assigned the same rank at the same lifecycle point addressed? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK036 Are requirements stated for what happens when a committed assessment or bug artifact fails a check, given FR-027 places them in scope? [Coverage, Spec §FR-027]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK037 Is the assumption that markup-tree documents are governed before any exist stated as a decision with its cost, rather than presented as fact? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK038 Is the dependency on an external, non-catalog source for some extensions acknowledged in the requirements rather than only in the plan? [Dependency, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK039 Are the amendment's non-goals stated specifically enough to settle whether a borderline change is in or out? [Clarity, Spec §Out of Scope]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Focus: the 2026-09-02 amendment only. Depth: standard. Audience: reviewer, before planning.
- CHK001 to CHK006 are the items this checklist exists for. The amendment relaxes a guarantee that previously held by construction into one that holds only if something checks it; if those six do not pass, the amendment has traded a structural property for a stated intention.
- CHK020, CHK023 and CHK024 test pairs of requirements that were written at different times and may not have been read against each other.
